summary.name: Tencent HY
summary.one_liner: Tencent HY (Hunyuan) is a multimodal large model family fully self-developed by Tencent, covering text, image, video and 3D content.
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Tencent Cloud documentation overview for Tencent HY, also called the Tencent HunYuan Large Model. It describes the model as a multimodal large model family fully self-developed by Tencent. It states that the models cover text, image, video and 3D modalities. The page says they target content production, knowledge Q&A and business automation, and are offered as enterprise-grade service. The page text contains no details on specific models, API endpoints, parameters or benchmarks.
notable: Covers text, image, video and 3D modalities in one model family
Offered as enterprise-grade service via Tencent Cloud documentation
caveats: Page text is a brief overview only; pricing and API details are not stated
Access appears to require contacting sales or submitting a ticket for help
